rationale.intuition: Stanford holistic review explicitly favors 'depth over breadth': 20 activities all 1-2 yrs with no leadership / no awards reads as 'resume padding' rather than sustained engagement. Compare against fixture 002 (same stats, 3 deep activities + national awards) — that profile clusters 3-10% admit. This profile should read LOWER due to lack of depth signal, despite identical academic stats. 真实 industry 区间 1-4% (resume-spread reads weaker than focused profile). Engine 当前 activityStrengthComponent 通过 calculateActivityScore(activityCount: 20, ...) 可能 over-credit 数量, 因为 activity count 是其中一个 input — 20 activities 触发 'too many' 但 yearsActive 平均 ~1.3 应触发 depth penalty. Whether engine has explicit depth penalty 是 fixture 想 probe 的 gap.

sources.name: Stanford Admissions Blog 'Things We Look For' 2023
sources.evidence: 'We are far more impressed by sustained, deep engagement in a few activities than by a long list of brief involvements. Quality over quantity.'

sources.name: Stanford CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Stanford overall RD admit rate ~3.7%; 'depth of involvement' is rated 'very important' factor in Section C7

sources.name: Crimson Education 'Activity Depth Analysis' 2024
sources.evidence: Profiles with 15+ activities all <2 years duration admitted at T5 schools at 0.3× the rate of profiles with 5-7 activities of 3-4 years; depth signal materially predicts outcomes

wontFix.reason: Engine activityStrengthComponent passes activityCount + activityDetails to calculateActivityScore; whether 'average yearsActive' is computed and used to penalize spread-thin profiles depends on calculateActivityScore implementation. Currently spike coherence (computeSpikeCoherence) clamps to [0.95, 1.10] which is too narrow to express 'this profile is 3× weaker than focused equivalent'. Depth-vs-breadth penalty is the textbook gap exposed by this fixture.
wontFix.followUp: Add explicit depth-penalty in activityStrengthComponent: if activities.length > 12 AND median yearsActive < 2, apply ~0.7× multiplier. Or extend computeSpikeCoherence to include depth dimension (not just category coherence). Track via 'activity depth' PR.
